content.title: Who Is Pugcasso on ‘The Masked Singer’ Season 14? Clues, Guesses, & Spoilers Revealed!
content.text: The Masked Singer is back! The season 14 finale of the hit FOX singing competition series aired on Wednesday night (April 1). The show, which began in South Korea, features celebrities singing songs while wearing costumes and face masks concealing their identities until they’re eliminated. Throughout the season, the contestants provide clues to try and help the judges and fans figure out who is under the mask. This season’s contestants boast a combined total of 94 million records sold, 21 platinum singles, 3 Emmy Award victories, 3 Hall of Famers, 3 World Series wins, and 54 million Instagram followers. For the Finale, Pugcasso first hit the stage for a performance of “True Colors” by Cyndi Lauper. He then returned to the stage for a performance of “Sussudio” by Phil Collins. Keep reading to see all of the clues and guesses…Keep scrolling to check out the clues and guesses… FIRST PERFORMANCE CLUES: - Says he was supposed to take over the family business, but changed careers - Baseball home plate painting - Big Ben statue shown - Came in first place in some sort of competition - Says he’s an “ordinary pup that lives in an extraordinary world” - Says he’s a “private person” PANEL GUESSES: Dan Reynolds, Darren Criss, & Ryan Tedder SECOND PERFORMANCE CLUES: - Grew up in a small town - He’s gone on tour, halfway across the world - He’s got a partner that keeps him grounded - Holds up “Bye Bye Bye” sign - Packs a matchbox into a suitcase - Holds up a Hawaiian shirt - He likes the beach and “cameras” PANEL GUESSES: Jack Johnson & Rob Thomas THIRD PERFORMANCE CLUES: - He’s a solo artist - “132 million” written across a sign - Did the biggest show of his life in another country - He performed alongside John Mayer and Bruce Springsteen - Moon shown - Lots of Spanish-language references - He was “rejected” - Says he was once told he “wasn’t good at music” PANEL GUESSES: Pat Monahan, Vance Joy, & Charlie Puth FOURTH PERFORMANCE CLUES: - Says this isn’t his first competition - Says he’s “taken the Olympics by storm” - Man comes out wearing a gold medal and holding an Olympic torch - Says “Being a part of the Olympics, it changed my life forever. I never imagined I’d have the whole world’s attention, so it was a pretty cool moment” PANEL GUESSES: Gavin DeGraw, Jason Mraz, and Pat Monahan FIFTH PERFORMANCE CLUES: - He has an audition tape from 2012 - Says everyone in America once had their eyes on him - He has a son - Wants to focus on music, not the celebrity aspect of his life/career - He’s once shared the stage with Jenny McCarthy PANEL GUESSES: Shay Mooney and Darren Criss FINALE CLUES: - Usually performs with just his microphone and guitar - Second-guesses his career choices a lot OUR GUESS: Phillip Phillips Based on the clues, we’re pretty sure that American Idol winner Phillip Phillips is under the Pugcasso mask. Phillip was born and raised in a small town in Georgia and before winning Idol in 2012, he was expected to take over his family’s pawn shop. His coronation song “Home” was a huge hit, and was used as part of the 2012 Summer Olympics campaign (which would connect with the home plate and Olympics clues). He made Idol history when he won his season with a record-breaking 132 million votes. Phillip and wife Hannah have two kids – a son named Patch born in November 2019 and a daughter named Isla born in June 2025.
